This plot is not mine — I rent it, so I do not want to spend too much money putting fertilizer into another man's soil. I grow cassava here mostly, with some beans between the rows to help my family's food. The rains in Mwanza are usually enough for cassava, so I do not irrigate, and I use cuttings from my last harvest like my neighbours do. I will put some manure from my goats because it is free, and I will weed with my wife and children, but if the weeds become too much near planting time I may call one or two people from the village to help for a few days.
